blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Test-time scaling systems often choose how much to sample, which prompt to use, and which verifier or aggregation rule to trust after repeatedly inspecting a calibration set. Standard validation error bars are not valid after this adaptive selection. We model a test-time scaling recipe as a randomized predictor with a random cost and prove a time-uniform PAC-Bayes certificate that holds simultaneously over all calibration times, all posterior mixtures over recipes, and all data-dependent stopping rules. Thus the same event covers the recipe search that precedes deployment, not merely the fixed recipe finally reported. For a finite grid of budgets and verifiers, the penalty is the familiar $\log M/n$, which in the worst case no certificate valid after selection can avoid, while non-uniform priors and localized posterior mixtures can give sharper certificates for structured searches. We specialize the result to self-consistency and show a complementary margin law: plurality voting improves exponentially in the sample budget only on examples where the correct answer is the generator's unique mode; otherwise more compute can provably amplify errors. The same margin analysis yields an oracle water-filling law for compute allocation. A synthetic audit quantifies the optimism caused by adaptive budget selection, and a 192-example GSM8K audit using gpt-4.1-mini generations illustrates risk-cost reporting for a real inference pipeline. At scale, with two models on GSM8K and MATH-500, selected-best error bars fall below the out-of-split GSM8K risk in up to 22.5% of random splits at a nominal 5% while the certificate never does, and on the full GSM8K test split it tightens to 0.109 (held-out risk 0.039). The results give a lightweight, distribution-free way to report risk and compute claims for adaptive inference systems.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en:
Large language models and other generative predictors increasingly trade inference-time compute for accuracy. Chain-of-thought prompting [ 33 ] , self-consistency [ 31 ] , best-of- N N selection, verifier-guided search, and compute-optimal allocation [ 29 ] all instantiate the same operational pattern: for a given input, run a stochastic procedure more than once and aggregate the outputs. Recent theory proves scaling laws for particular aggregation mechanisms [ 9 , 37 , 12 ] . Yet the way these systems are selected in practice is more adaptive than the way they are often certified. A practitioner sweeps budgets, prompts, temperatures, verifiers, pruning thresholds, and stopping rules; inspects the same validation curve many times; and finally reports the best-looking point. Statistically, this is a model-selection problem with optional stopping.
The central question of this paper is simple: After adaptively choosing a test-time scaling recipe from a monitored calibration transcript, what risk and compute can be certified without making parametric assumptions on the data distribution or the generator? We give a time-uniform PAC-Bayes certificate for randomized inference recipes. A recipe may encode the prompt, sampling temperature, budget, verifier, aggregation rule, or per-example stopping policy. A posterior distribution over recipes may be chosen after seeing the calibration transcript. With high probability, all such choices satisfy a binary-kl risk bound at every time. The result is intentionally modest in its assumptions: examples are i.i.d.; losses and normalized costs are bounded; the prior over recipes does not depend on the calibration transcript. No realizability, margin, or well-specified verifier assumption is required for the certificate itself.
blocks.zh:
大型语言模型和其他基因预测器越来越多地以推断时间计算准确性。 思维链激发[33],自我一致性[31],最佳N选择,验证方指导的搜索,以及计算-最佳分配[29] 都即时化了相同的操作模式:对于给定输入,不止一次运行有条理的程序并汇总输出. 最近的理论证明了特定聚合机制的缩放定律[9,37,12]. 然而,在实践中选择这些系统的方式比往往经过认证的方式更具适应性。 一个执业者扫荡预算,提示,温度,验证器,刷新阈值,并停止规则;多次检查相同的验证曲线;最后报告最优的点. 从统计学上来说,这是选择停站的模型选择问题.
本文的中心问题很简单: 在适应性地从受监测的校准记录中选择测试时间缩放配方后,在不对数据分布或生成器作出参数假设的情况下,可以验证哪些风险和计算? 我们为随机推论配方提供时间统一的PAC-Bayes证书. 食谱可以编码迅速、采样温度、预算、核查、汇总规则,或每例停止政策。 在看到校准笔录后,可选择在食谱上进行后传. 由于概率很高,所有这样的选择每次都能满足二进制-kl的风险。 其假设是故意的,结果不大:实例是 " d. " ;损失和正常费用是受限的;先前的食谱不取决于校准记录。 证书本身不需要可实现性、比值或明确规定的核查人假设。

blocks.en: This target differs from the usual fixed-recipe analysis. A theorem showing that a particular voting, search, or verifier rule improves with more compute does not by itself justify choosing among many such rules after inspecting the same labeled calibration set. Likewise, an unlabeled certificate that a vote has found the generator’s terminal-distribution mode does not certify that the mode is correct. Our certificate covers the labeled risk and realized cost of the recipe selected by an adaptive audit, while the self-consistency analysis below explains when mode concentration should or should not be expected to help. The same high-probability event must survive five features that occur together in LLM inference audits: randomized recipes, random normalized cost, posterior mixtures over recipes, optional stopping in a monitored calibration transcript, and localized priors chosen from a predeclared family after seeing the transcript. The proof uses classical ingredients, in particular the stitching argument of [ 10 , Cors. 22 and 25] ; what is new is the certified object and its consequences ( Section 9 ).
blocks.zh: 这个目标与通常的固定循环分析不同. 如果定理表明某项表决、搜索或核查规则在计算上有所改进,则在检查同一标定的校准套件后,在很多这类规则中作出选择本身并不有道理。 同样,一个未加标签的证明,即投票已经找到生成器的终端分配模式,并不能证明该模式是正确的。 我们的证明书涵盖经适应性审计选择的食谱的标签风险和已实现的成本,而下面的自我一致性分析则解释了何时应该或不应该期望模式浓度有所帮助. 同样的高概率事件必须幸存在LLM推论审计中同时出现的五个特征上:随机化食谱,随机正常化成本,后置混合物比食谱多,可选停在监控的校准笔录中,以及看到笔录后从预先申报的家庭中选择的本地化前缀. 证明使用了古典成分,特别是[10,Cors. 22和25]的缝合论证;新的是认证对象及其后果(第9节)。

blocks.en: We prove an anytime-valid PAC-Bayes certificate for the random loss and random cost of test-time scaling recipes, valid after data-dependent posterior selection and optional stopping ( Section 4 ). We turn the bound into a concrete audit protocol with explicit priors, deterministic tie-breaking, and risk-cost reporting ( Section 5 ). We characterize when self-consistency helps or hurts through a per-example margin law, and derive the associated water-filling oracle allocation rule ( Section 6 ). We show that a log ⁡ M / n \log M/n selection penalty is unavoidable in the worst case for finite adaptive sweeps, matching the certificate’s dependence on the number of inspected recipes, with leading constant one when log ⁡ M ≫ log ⁡ n \log M\gg\log n ( Section 7 ). We validate the reporting workflow with a synthetic audit and a 192-example GSM8K audit using gpt-4.1-mini generations, and at scale with two models on GSM8K and MATH-500, including recipe grids over prompts, temperatures, verifiers, early stopping, and routing; the appendices add calibration-size, random-split, sweep-size, and prior-allocation stress tests ( Section 8 , Appendices C , E and G ).

blocks.en: The argument combines the binary-kl moment bound of [ 23 ] , the change of measure of [ 7 ] , and the stitching argument of [ 10 , Cors. 22 and 25] (Cors. 5.1 and 5.3 of arXiv v5), applied with one epoch per calibration time. For a fixed recipe and a fixed calibration size, the empirical mean satisfies a sharp binary-kl exponential moment bound. Averaging this exponential moment under the prior and applying a PAC-Bayes change-of-measure inequality makes the bound simultaneous over all posterior mixtures. Joint convexity of binary relative entropy then moves the kl outside the posterior average. Finally, a summable union bound over n n , with failure probability δ / [ n ⁡ ( n + 1 ) ] \delta/[n(n+1)] at time n n , gives a single event that holds at every calibration time. Optional stopping is therefore not a separate martingale argument in the deployment rule; it is already paid for by the time-uniform event. Appendix A gives the proof, including the bounded cost case, using standard PAC-Bayes and binary-kl moment facts.

blocks.en: For a small finite grid, the uniform prior gives the transparent log ⁡ M \log M penalty in Corollary 4.3 , and at realistic calibration sizes the time-uniform term Θ ⁡ ( log ⁡ n / n ) \Theta(\log n/n) dominates log ⁡ M / n \log M/n . For larger searches, the prior is part of the audit trail: cheap, simple, or historically preferred recipes can receive more mass, while speculative recipes receive less ( Section G.6 ). A recipe outside the support of the prior needs a new audit round on fresh data. Posterior mixtures are useful when several recipes have similar certificates, because the certificate then applies to the randomized deployment itself rather than to an unstable post-hoc winner ( Section 8.2 ).

The held-out split can reveal implementation errors, distribution mismatch, or accidental overfitting to an unmodeled part of the pipeline; it should not be used to change the selected recipe unless it is folded into a new certified selection round.

We additionally store raw model generations and token usage before parsing. If only parsed answers are retained, later parser changes can silently change the audited recipe. blocks.en: Proposition 6.1 is deliberately label-aware. A high-confidence vote certifies agreement with the generator’s mode; it does not by itself certify correctness. When the correct answer is the unique mode, the error of self-consistency decays exponentially in b b . The forward bound is the Chernoff form of Theorem 2.2 in [ 12 ] , whose Theorem 2.3 shows that its exponent is exact, and the converse applies their pairwise bound [ 12 , App. A.4] to a wrong answer. blocks.en: We include a small simulation to make the selection issue visible. Each task has a latent single-trace correctness probability p X p_{X} . Easy tasks draw p X p_{X} from a distribution concentrated above 1 / 2 1/2 , while adversarial tasks draw p X p_{X} mostly below 1 / 2 1/2 ; self-consistency with budget b b is the majority vote of b b Bernoulli traces. We sweep b ∈ { 1 , 3 , 5 , 9 , 17 , 33 , 65 } b\in\{1,3,5,9,17,33,65\} on a calibration set, choose the budget with the smallest empirical risk, and compare three quantities over repeated trials: selected empirical risk, true selected risk, and the PAC-Bayes upper certificate with a uniform prior over budgets.

We also run a larger real LLM audit on GSM8K [ 11 ] using gpt-4.1-mini. The reported transcript contains 192 test examples, split into 96 calibration and 96 held-out examples, and sweeps budgets { 1 , 3 , 5 , 9 } \{1,3,5,9\} , for 1728 stochastic solution traces in total. Budget 1 has calibration risk 3 / 96 3/96 , while budgets 3, 5, and 9 have calibration risk 2 / 96 2/96 ; deterministic risk-cost tie-breaking selects budget 3, whose held-out risk is 1 / 96 1/96 . The selected PAC-Bayes upper certificate is 0.219 0.219 , compared with 0.240 0.240 for the single-trace budget. Table 3 in Appendix C reports the full risk-cost summary, the protocol, and the exact reproduction command. Using the same derived per-example audit table, we also vary the calibration size from 32 to 160 examples. The selected certificate falls overall from 0.350 0.350 to 0.159 0.159 as calibration grows, and the prefix splits consistently select budget 3. A random-split resampling audit gives the same qualitative picture: over 3000 calibration splits, the probability of selecting budget 3 rises from 0.518 0.518 at 32 calibration examples to 0.999 0.999 at 160 calibration examples. Full sensitivity plots and tables are in Appendix C .

blocks.en: 9 Related Work
blocks.zh: 9 相关工作

blocks.en: Chain-of-thought prompting [ 33 ] and self-consistency [ 31 ] showed that sampling multiple reasoning paths can improve exact-answer reasoning. Tree-of-thought search [ 36 ] , verifier-guided best-of- N N [ 11 ] , process or step-aware verifiers [ 22 , 20 ] , repeated sampling [ 6 ] , and compute-optimal inference studies [ 29 , 34 ] all treat inference-time compute as a selectable resource. Recent theory analyzes specific scaling rules, including black-box knockout or league aggregation [ 9 ] , sampling-based confidence estimation [ 37 ] , and mode-recovery certificates for self-consistency [ 12 , 25 ] . Our certificate instead covers labeled deployment risk and random cost for the recipe selected after a monitored sweep.
blocks.zh: 思维链激发[33]和自我一致性[31]表明,取样多条推理路径可以改进准确答案推理. 深思之树搜索 [36],核查者-指导最佳N N [11],过程或步骤识别验证者 [22,20],重复采样 [6],以及计算-最佳推论研究 [29,34] 均将推论时间计算视为可选资源. 近期理论分析了具体的缩放规则,包括黑盒淘汰或联赛汇总[9],基于采样的置信估计[37],以及自我一致性模式恢复证书[12,25]. 我们的证书则涵盖了标签上的部署风险和在监控扫描后选择的食谱的随机成本。

blocks.en: Conformal prediction and related risk-control methods provide finite-sample calibration guarantees for black-box predictive systems under exchangeability [ 30 , 4 ] . Learn-then-test extends this perspective to broader risk functionals by casting calibration as a multiple-testing problem [ 2 ] , and has been applied to a sampling budget [ 26 ] . Adaptive data analysis and post-selection inference make the same warning in different language: reusing data to choose analyses can invalidate ordinary empirical claims [ 14 , 27 , 5 ] .
blocks.zh: 正规预测和相关的风险控制方法为可交换性下的黑箱预测系统提供了有限样本校准保证[30,4]. 学习-当时测试将这一视角延伸至更广泛的风险功能,将校准铸成多重测试问题[2],并已应用于抽样预算[26]。 适应性数据分析和选后推论用不同语言发出同样的警告:重用数据来选择分析可以使普通的经验性索赔无效[14,27,5].

blocks.en: PAC-Bayes bounds [ 24 ] were sharpened by work including [ 28 , 23 , 7 ] ; PAC-Bayesian majority-vote analyses are classical [ 15 ] . Time-uniform inference is commonly developed through nonnegative supermartingales and confidence sequences [ 17 ] , and [ 10 ] give a general time-uniform PAC-Bayes recipe. What is classical and what is new. The stitching argument of [ 10 , Cors. 22 and 25] already yields time-uniform binary-kl PAC-Bayes bounds; our allocation δ / [ n ⁡ ( n + 1 ) ] \delta/[n(n+1)] is that construction with one epoch per calibration time, which keeps coefficient one on KL ( Q ∥ P ) + log ( 1 / δ ) \operatorname{KL}(Q\|P)+\log(1/\delta) at every n n and admits the approximate closed form ( 2 ), whereas dyadic epochs have a smaller additive log ⁡ n \log n term; neither form dominates. The mixture prior of Theorem 4.4 is textbook PAC-Bayes, and on countable grids weighted unions of anytime confidence sequences [ 17 , 32 ] also cover selection and stopping, and they were tighter than our certificate on our full-scale audits ( Section G.2 ). The forward half of Proposition 6.1 is Theorem 2.2 of [ 12 ] , which certifies mode recovery without labels, as does [ 25 ] . New here are the certified object, the labeled risk and cost of a recipe selected by an adaptive sweep, priced by KL ( Q ∥ P ) \operatorname{KL}(Q\|P) over arbitrary recipe spaces, the label-aware risk decomposition and its wrong-mode reading, the allocation law, and the sharp-constant and code-length lower bounds, which extend the Occam tightness construction of [ 19 , Thm. 4.4] .
blocks.zh: PAC-Bayes的界限[24]通过包括[28、23、7]在内的工作而更加清晰;PAC-Bayesian的多数投票分析是典型的[15]。 时间统一推论通常通过非负超推论和置信序列[17],[10]给出一般时间统一PAC-Bayes配方来发展. 什么是古典的,什么是新的。 [10, Cors. 22 和 25] 的缝合参数已经产生时间- uniform binary-kl PAC-Bayes 的界限;我们的分配 δ / [n(n + 1)]\delta/[n(n)+1] 是每个校准时间一个时段的构造,它使系数值保持在 KL(Q)+log(1 / )\ operatorname{KL}(Q)\P)\log(1/\delta) 上,并且承认大约的封闭形式 (2),而dyadic epoches 的添加日志 → n\log n 名名词; 既不是支配。 定理4.4之前的混合物是教科书PAC-Bayes,在任何信任序列的可计数网格加权结合[17,32]中也包括选择和停止,它们比我们全面审计的证明更为严格(G.2节)。 Proposition 6.1的前半部分是[12]的定理2.2,该定理证明模式回收没有标签,[25] 也是如此. 这里新建的是认证对象,标签上的风险和成本,由适应性扫描所选择的食谱,由KL(QQ P)\operatorname{KL}(QQP)对任意食谱空间定价,标签意识风险分解及其错误模式读取,分配法,以及尖锐的恒和码长的下限,扩展了Occam紧度构造[19, Thm. 4.4].

blocks.en: 10 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 10. 结论

blocks.en: Adaptive test-time scaling turns inference design into sequential model selection. A validation curve inspected many times is not a certificate by itself. Theorem 4.1 gives a simple anytime-valid PAC-Bayes certificate for the risk and cost of the recipe finally chosen, and Proposition 6.1 explains why self-consistency needs such label-aware validation: scaling stabilizes the generator’s mode whether or not that mode is correct. The resulting message is practical: predeclare a prior over the inference search space, monitor calibration performance freely, and report the selected recipe with its PAC-Bayes risk-cost certificate.
blocks.zh: 适应性测试时间缩放将推论设计转化为顺序模型选择. 多次检查的验证曲线本身并不是证书。 定理4.1为最终选择的食谱的风险和成本提供了简单且随时有效的PAC-Bayes证书,而Proposition 6.1解释为什么自我一致性需要这种具有标签意识的验证:无论该模式是否正确,缩放稳定了生成器的模式. 由此产生的信息是实用的:在推论搜索空间上预先声明一个前题,自由监测校准性能,并用其PAC-Bayes风险成本证书报告选定的食谱.

blocks.en: The script scripts/real_llm_audit.py implements the real benchmark audit on the GSM8K test split [ 11 ] . For each problem it queries an OpenAI-compatible chat-completions endpoint for b max b_{\max} stochastic solutions using a fixed prompt that asks for a final numeric answer. For every budget b ∈ { 1 , 3 , 5 , 9 } b\in\{1,3,5,9\} , or any user-specified odd grid, it takes the first b b traces, extracts the final number from each trace, applies deterministic plurality voting, and records exact-answer correctness against the GSM8K answer. The first n cal n_{\mathrm{cal}} examples form the calibration transcript used to select the budget with the smallest empirical risk; the remaining examples are reported only as a held-out sanity check. The selected calibration risk is converted into the finite-grid specialization of Corollary 4.3 . The implementation optionally stores intermediate model outputs by model, prompt version, example hash, trace index, temperature, and token limit, so interrupted runs can be resumed without changing the transcript.

A MATH-500 answer is the last \boxed{} content, lightly normalized (whitespace, \dfrac , \left / \right , trailing units and percent signs, numeric canonicalization). blocks.en: The certificate is distribution-free but not assumption-free. It requires an i.i.d. calibration sample from the deployment distribution, bounded loss and bounded normalized cost, and a prior that does not depend on the calibration transcript. If the deployment distribution shifts, the guarantee applies to the calibration distribution, not the shifted one. The bound can also be numerically loose for very small calibration sets or extremely large unstructured sweeps ( Section G.2 ). The theory certifies the risk of the selected inference recipe; it does not certify the truthfulness of generated rationales, the safety of model outputs outside the measured label space, or fairness across unmeasured subpopulations. The margin law and the allocation law are statements about the per-example answer distribution; their plug-in use is audited empirically ( Section 8.2 ), not guaranteed, and a certificate for the selected recipe does not rank recipes ( Section G.4 ).
blocks.zh: 证书是无发行但并非无假设的. 它需要从部署分配中抽取一.d校准样本,定界损失和定界正常成本,以及不取决于校准记录的先验. 如果部署分配转移,则保证适用于校准分配,而不是转向分配。 对于极小的校准装置或极大的无结构扫荡(G.2节),捆绑也可以在数字上松开. 该理论验证了选定推论食谱的风险;它不证明生成的理由的真实性,在所测量的标签空间外模型输出的安全性,或未经测量的亚人群之间的公平性. 差值法和分配法是对每例答案分配的说明;其插值使用经过实证审计(第8.2节),没有保证,对所选食谱的证书不排序食谱(G.4节).

blocks.en: The societal effect of the work is mostly indirect. Better certificates for adaptive inference can improve transparency when expensive reasoning systems are deployed, but they can also make more capable generation pipelines easier to tune. We therefore view the certificate as an audit tool rather than a standalone safety mechanism.
blocks.zh: 工作的社会影响大多是间接的。 在部署昂贵的推理系统时,更好的适应性推论证书可以提高透明度,但也可以使更有能力的生成管道更容易调谐. 因此,我们认为证书是一种审计工具,而不是一个独立的安全机制。
